lines.text: All stations, break, break! Strategic weapon away! Flashback is in the air. Turn away from the target. Get below cover. Do not look at the flash!
lines.direction: eleven_v4 with heavy emotion tags via REST 2026-11-21 (take 1 stability 0, take 2 stability 0.3)

lines.text: Flash! Flash! Nuclear detonation! All aircraft, turn away! The shock front is coming. Get down, get down!
lines.direction: eleven_v4 with heavy emotion tags via REST 2026-11-21 (take 1 stability 0, take 2 stability 0.3)

lines.text: Everything is on fire! Get those people inside! Away from the windows! Oh God, the trees are gone! Command, do you read?
lines.direction: eleven_v4 with heavy emotion tags via REST 2026-11-21 (take 1 stability 0, take 2 stability 0.3)

lines.text: Skywatch, this is Dagger! I've lost the whole flight! There's nothing on the scope! Somebody answer me!
lines.direction: eleven_v4 with heavy emotion tags via REST 2026-11-21 (take 1 stability 0, take 2 stability 0.3)

lines.text: We can't see the sun. The roof is coming down! Get back! Command, please, we're still here! We are still...
